title: Feedback record
description: One append-only record of human or agent feedback on a generated output (AES-V2.3 / SUE-561). Distinct from a reference evaluation: this judges what the system produced, not third-party material. See docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §5 (layers) and §6 (four separate signals, never averaged).

ref.description: Id or path of the generated thing this feedback is about.

basis.description: explicit_human_feedback: the human said it. model_inference: an agent judged it.

signal.description: The four V2 signals stay separate and are never averaged into one score.

statement.description: What the human actually said, verbatim where possible.

scope.description: task_local (the safe default) or calibration_candidate. A single record may never be calibration_candidate on its own basis alone — see references/REFERENCE-EVALUATION-PROTOCOL.md and AES-V2.10, which owns promotion into durable calibration.

routing.description: Which layer (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §5) produced the failure or success this feedback names. Abstention must be expressible: layer null with abstained true says the record could not tell rather than guessing.

modality_layer.description: Modality-specific routing detail, e.g. a TEXT/VISUAL/AUDIO sub-concern. Free text; the shared layer above is the enumerated one.

abstained.description: True when this record cannot name a layer with confidence.
